onrep.plainEnglish: In plain English, Replication and OnRep means: Replication ships the number. OnRep is the local reaction. A limb write nested inside HasAuthority becomes Health, or LeftArm, on the server, clamped so a normal hit cannot pass 10% of max. OnRep plays the limp on every proxy that has the pawn. A second subtract in the notify bites twice. A medal's OnRep refreshes the board and does not add 10 again. EquippedId's OnRep rebuilds a third-person mesh from the asset and does not invent a new id.
onrep.whyGame: In a real game, getting replication and onrep wrong shows up as subtracting with no clamp so health goes negative and the death branch never sees zero. the damage event on this local pawn is the repair, and the generated line `Health = FMath::Clamp((Health - Damage), 0.f, MaxHealth); // node:tpl_health_set` is that repair in C++.
